name: Unlock Bubble Net Route
summary: Open insect catching around DG6, confirm the Bubble Net route, and catch one easy insect first.
steps: Reach the DG6-style insect unlock window
Find the mentor or shop route for Bubble Net
Equip Bubble Net before habitat checks
Catch one common insect before chasing rare routes

name: Time Window Route
summary: Time gates matter more than walking speed: separate day, evening, and night insects.
steps: Check the target's time window before walking
Use daytime for common meadow and town checks
Use evening for forest or lamp routes
Use night only when the target list needs it

name: Weather And Rain Route
summary: Rain and special weather should trigger targeted catches instead of generic loops.
steps: Check weather before spending the route
Run rain-only insect checks first
Skip rare weather targets during normal weather
Archive failed windows in checklist notes

name: Habitat Sweep Route
summary: Sweep trees, flowers, water edges, and mountain paths as separate route lanes.
steps: Start with flower field and town plants
Check forest tree routes next
Use water edges when fishing nearby
Save mountain insects for onsen or resource loops

name: Rare Bug Priority
summary: Track rare insects by time, weather, and habitat so the route has a real success condition.
steps: Record missing rare insect candidates
Attach time and weather gates to each target
Run only matching habitat lanes
Stop after one confirmed catch or window miss

name: Sell Or Save Decision
summary: Treat insects as a collection and money route: confirm whether the catch is needed before selling duplicates.
steps: Check whether the insect is a first catch
Save collection or request items first
Sell duplicate common insects only after notes are clear
Use profit tools for broader money route decisions
